sources.recommend_reason_zh: AlphaGenome 2预测DNA变异如何影响数百种人类细胞类型，基于68种组织、超1亿个单细胞图谱训练，识别出比前代近两倍改变基因表达的变异。

en.reason: AlphaGenome 2 predicts how DNA variants affect hundreds of human cell types, drawing on 68 tissues and a single-cell atlas of over 100 million cells to identify nearly twice as many expression-altering variants as its predecessor.

sources.title: Google Deepmind 的 AlphaProof Code 用四周就完成了 Signal 密码学核心的验证，而以往这需要数年 / Google Deepmind's AlphaProof Code verified Signal's cryptographic core in four weeks instead of years

sources.title_en: Google Deepmind's AlphaProof Code verified Signal's cryptographic core in four weeks instead of years

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Google Deepmind的AlphaProof Code仅用四周就数学验证了Signal加密核心代码，而通常需数年；Gemini Carbon驱动的AI agents写出超六百万行Lean证明，仅约百分之一交人工审查，还立即发现两个故意植入的bug。

sources.summary:
Google join Jev and OpenAI in the decision model category with "Gemini Decision 1". This new model API is almost identical to Jev: it supports the same three types of …
11th November 2026 - Link Blog
Gemini Decisions API ( via ) Google join Jev and OpenAI in the decision model category with "Gemini Decision 1". This new model API is almost identical to Jev: it supports the same three types of questions (yes/no, choice, and rubric-scoring) and even reuses Jev's term "Noul" for a yes/no question.
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Google发布Gemini Decision 1加入决策模型竞争，支持yes/no、choice和rubric-scoring三类问题，每百万输入token定价10美分、输出免费，比Jev的4.2美分贵，但支持文本、图像、音频、视频和PDF多模态输入。

en.reason: Google's Gemini Decision 1 enters the decision-model race with yes/no, choice and rubric-scoring questions, $0.10 per million input tokens and free output, undercut by Jev's 4.2 cents despite multimodal text, image, audio, video and PDF input.

sources.title_original: AI 都帮我干活了，为什么我还是这么累？聊聊 AI 工作流的工程化
sources.summary: 很多人用AI只是单点提效，依然困在逐一审阅、反复纠错的繁重工作里。作者受SpaceX工程师Poteto的多Agent系统启发，落地了LLM-as-a-Judge自动评估方案，还给出了循序渐进的搭建思路！
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章以SpaceX首席工程师Poteto一个月交付约2000–2500个PR为例，讲她靠多Agent协作和pstack Skills搭系统，而非逐个给AI下指令、再逐个检查拍板。

en.title: AI Is Already Doing My Work—So Why Am I Still So Exhausted? Let's Talk About Engineering AI Workflows
en.summary: Many people use AI only for isolated productivity gains and remain trapped in heavy work—reviewing items one by one and fixing errors over and over. Inspired by SpaceX engineer Poteto's multi-Agent system, the author implemented an LLM-as-a-Judge automated evaluation approach and laid out a step-by-step guide to building it.
en.reason: SpaceX chief engineer Poteto delivered roughly 2,000–2,500 pull requests in one month by building a multi-agent system with pstack Skills and LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation, showing how to escape one-by-one AI review and error-fixing.

sources.summary: 这套基于Floatboat搭建的外贸工作台，把寻找海外线索、AI制作工业图、快速生成单页站、邮件处理、外贸英语陪练收拢在一处，可以不用在多软件来回切换。本地SQLite存储客户数据，还支持后台长任务、接入主流模型，一次性成本很低。在做外贸的小伙伴儿可以试试！
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章讲作者如何在 Floatboat 上搭出外贸工作台，把 AI 作图、海外询盘线索搜寻、单页独立站生成与邮件处理收进同一入口，客户数据存本地 SQLite，标价 600 积分、2.4 刀（约 16 元）。

en.title: In the AI era, smart exporters should stop paying for a stack of tools
en.summary: This foreign-trade workbench built on Floatboat brings overseas lead generation, AI-generated industrial graphics, quick single-page site creation, email handling, and foreign-trade English practice into one place, so you no longer have to switch between multiple apps. Customer data is stored locally in SQLite, and it supports long-running background tasks and integration with mainstream models, all at a very low one-time cost. Anyone doing foreign trade should give it a try!
en.reason: A Floatboat-based foreign-trade workbench consolidates overseas lead searching, AI industrial imagery, single-page site generation, email handling and English practice into one entry point, storing customer data in local SQLite for a listed 600 credits, $2.4 (about 16 yuan).

sources.summary: Google正式开放Gemini 4 Carbon，主打深度推理与长周期Agent任务，拥有百万token统一上下文窗口，还支持三档推理深度调节。它适合Bug审查、架构设计、科学推导等高难度场景，可搭配Argon、Flash组成多智能体分工流水线。文中附带定价、迁移要点与五条落地实战技巧，可以上手试试。

en.title: Gemini 4 Carbon: A Developer's Guide
en.summary: Google has officially opened up Gemini 4 Carbon, built for deep reasoning and long-horizon Agent tasks, with a unified million-token context window and three adjustable reasoning depth levels. It's suited to demanding work like Bug review, architecture design, and scientific derivation, and can be paired with Argon and Flash to form a multi-agent pipeline with divided roles. The article covers pricing, migration tips, and five practical pointers for putting it to work — worth a try.
en.reason: Gemini 4 Carbon provides a unified 1M-token context window and three reasoning levels via the Gemini API; this guide covers its $2 per 1M input and $10 per 1M output pricing, migration tips and multi-agent pipelines with Argon and Flash.

en.title: Gemini 4 Carbon: A Developer's Guide
en.summary: Google has officially opened up Gemini 4 Carbon, built for deep reasoning and long-horizon Agent tasks, with a unified million-token context window and three adjustable reasoning depth levels. It's suited to demanding work like Bug review, architecture design, and scientific derivation, and can be paired with Argon and Flash to form a multi-agent pipeline with divided roles. The article covers pricing, migration tips, and five practical pointers for putting it to work — worth a try.
en.reason: Gemini 4 Carbon provides a unified 1M-token context window and three reasoning levels via the Gemini API; this guide covers its $2 per 1M input and $10 per 1M output pricing, migration tips and multi-agent pipelines with Argon and Flash.

sources.summary: 当个人Agent已经很难拉动组织效率，模数OPC社区带来了一套可落地的Team Agent实战方案。6人团队依托分域权限、事项绑定上下文的机制，让数字员工承接业务全链路，仅关键节点保留人工把关，搭配每日知识蒸馏形成持续学习的闭环。正在搭建团队AI协作体系的人，可以借鉴下。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 北京亦庄8000平方米的模数OPC社区已入驻100家OPC，6人运营团队以真实业务讲述如何从Work、Personal Agent走到Team Agent，用嵌入组织的Agent接住人和人之间的那一段。

en.title: After Everyone Has an Agent: Building Team Agent in Our Own AI Community
en.summary: When a personal Agent alone can no longer move the needle on organizational efficiency, the Modu OPC community has put together a practical, deployable playbook for Team Agents. A six-person team relies on domain-scoped permissions and context-bound tasks to let digital employees cover the entire business chain, keeping human review only at key checkpoints, and pairs this with daily knowledge distillation to form a continuous learning loop. Worth a look for anyone building a team AI collaboration system.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: AO3因安全事件下线最多四周，超1880万篇作品被读者搬上Google Drives，作者Avery发现自己的文未经同意出现在镜像站，文章讲清读者存档与作者控制权的冲突。

en.reason: AO3’s security shutdown of up to four weeks led readers to copy over 18.8 million works to Google Drives, while author Avery found her fic on mirror sites without consent, highlighting archiving versus author control.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Snowflake AI Research 用 Harness 动态裁剪上下文、按需发现工具，并以 Semantic Views 预置业务规则；其 SQL 修复基准中 CoCo 用 Sonnet 5 三次试验通过率 86%，高于 Claude Code 用 Opus 5 的 72%。

en.reason: Snowflake AI Research's Harness dynamically prunes context and discovers tools on demand while Semantic Views preload business rules, and its SQL repair benchmark shows CoCo with Sonnet 5 at 86% versus Claude Code with Opus 5 at 72%.

stories.title: 为什么仅靠培训无法弥合AI落地与ROI之间的差距 / Why training alone can’t close the gap between AI adoption and ROI

sources.title: 为什么仅靠培训无法弥合AI落地与ROI之间的差距 / Why training alone can’t close the gap between AI adoption and ROI
sources.title_zh: 为什么仅靠培训无法弥合AI落地与ROI之间的差距
sources.title_en: Why training alone can’t close the gap between AI adoption and ROI
sources.title_original: Why training alone can’t close the gap between AI adoption and ROI
sources.summary:
75% of L&D teams say faster content creation is AI's clearest impact, but only 11% name improved on-the-job performance. Synthesia's Amy Vidor argues leaders must align on outcomes, integrate data, and partner with L&D before training can close the AI-to-ROI gap.
75% of L&D teams say faster content creation is AI's clearest impact, but only 11% name improved on-the-job performance. Synthesia's Amy Vidor argues leaders must align on outcomes, integrate data, and partner with L&D before training c
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 调查800多名L&D从业者显示，75%认为AI最明显效果是更快制作内容，仅11%提到改善在岗表现；Synthesia的Amy Vidor指出，领导者须先对齐成果、整合数据并与L&D合作，培训才能弥合AI到ROI的差距。

en.reason: A survey of over 800 L&D practitioners found 75% cite faster content creation as AI's clearest impact while only 11% name improved on-the-job performance, and Synthesia's Amy Vidor argues leaders must align on outcomes, integrate data and partner with L&D before training closes the AI-to-ROI gap.

en.reason: Microsoft will turn on Claude by default in UK Copilot from 9 December unless admins opt out, with Anthropic processing data in the US, as IPPR says only 15.4% of public sector spending with largest 150 tech suppliers stays UK-owned.

Top chip manufacturer TSMC is ready to invest $1 billion in Anthropic and OpenAI. That would give the Taiwanese chipmaker direct stakes in leading AI developers, even as its own contract c

en.reason: TSMC’s board approved up to $500 million for OpenAI preferred stock and another $500 million for Anthropic common stock at its expected IPO price, giving the chipmaker stakes in two developers that heavily buy its AI chips.

sources.title_original: 'Model weights need the same level of scrutiny as code': Microsoft researchers find AI agents can be backdoored by editing just a few neurons
sources.summary:
What if your AI agent behaved normally and then just "snapped"?
What if your AI agent behaved normally and then just "snapped"?

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Microsoft 研究人员发现，仅需编辑少数几个神经元，就能给 AI agent 植入后门，让它平时表现正常、关键时刻突然失控，并主张模型权重应像代码一样接受同等审查。

en.reason: Microsoft researchers found that editing only a few neurons can backdoor an AI agent to behave normally until it suddenly snaps, arguing model weights need the same scrutiny as code.
